projectTiers.label: Build your online presence
projectTiers.intro: Three clear ways to start, plus custom projects for bigger scopes. The highlighted example investment shows a sensible package to discuss; the range and checkout starting amount are shown separately.

tiers.name: GBP Content Refresh
tiers.description: No new website. On-site photo, short-form video, and a cleaned-up Google Business Profile so locals see quality now.
tiers.scopeDriver: Entry offer when you need fresh visuals and GBP setup without rebuilding the site.
includes: Google Business Profile optimization (categories, services, photos, posts)

stripe.billingNote: Starting price within the $400 to $600 range. Final scope is confirmed after a short intake.

tiers.recommendedDetails: One local shoot, a defined set of edited visuals, and a Google Business Profile refresh.
tiers.checkoutNote: Secure booking starts at $400. Final deliverables and total are confirmed after intake.

tiers.name: Website Only
tiers.description: A conversion-focused site built and customized on Webflow or Shopify when you already have usable photos and copy.
tiers.scopeDriver: $800 to $1,000 for a simple 1- to 5-page brochure site. $1,200 to $1,500 for more pages, Shopify setup, booking or lead forms, or extra revision rounds.
includes: Site built and customized on Webflow or Shopify
Basic SEO foundations and launch support

stripe.billingNote: Starting price within the $800 to $1,500 range. You supply photos and copy. Final scope confirmed after intake.

tiers.bestFor: MAKE IT EASY TO BOOK YOU
tiers.recommendedDetails: A focused multi-page site using the photos and copy you already have.
tiers.checkoutNote: Secure booking starts at $800. The $1,200 example is a more complete business-site scope.

tiers.name: Website + Content Capture
tiers.description: Website build plus a 2- to 4-hour on-location photo and video shoot, edited and placed on the site and Google Business Profile.
tiers.scopeDriver: Right fit when the business looks better in person than online and needs both a site and real content in one project.
includes: Half-day on-location photo and video shoot
Edited assets for the site and GBP

stripe.billingNote: Starting price within the $2,000 to $2,800 range for a half-day shoot + site. Final scope confirmed after intake.

tiers.bestFor: SHOW THE WORK, THEN SELL IT
tiers.recommendedDetails: A conversion-focused site and one on-location session for authentic photo and video.
tiers.checkoutNote: Secure booking starts at $2,000. Final project quote depends on pages, shoot time and edits.

tiers.name: Website + Extended Content
tiers.description: Larger site with more pages or stakeholder complexity, plus a full-day content shoot across multiple locations or product lines.
tiers.scopeDriver: For multi-location businesses, ministries, or catalogs that need deeper coverage. Larger church and multi-stakeholder projects land near the top of this range.
includes: Full-day content shoot (multiple locations or products)

stripe.billingNote: Starting price within the $3,000 to $4,500+ range. Multi-location or complex builds may quote higher after intake.

tiers.recommendedDetails: For larger websites, multiple locations, bigger catalogs or more production time.
tiers.checkoutNote: Secure booking starts at $3,000; expanded scope is quoted individually.

ongoingTiers.label: Stay visible after launch
ongoingTiers.intro: Your website is the foundation. Monthly content keeps it fresh. Agree on the shoot schedule, assets, and channels before starting a retainer.

tiers.name: Content + Growth Retainer
tiers.description: Ongoing monthly photo and video content, GBP posting, and review management for businesses that already have a site.
tiers.scopeDriver: Scope depends on shoot frequency and how many channels we keep current each month.

stripe.billingNote: Starting monthly rate within the $450 to $800 band. Month-to-month. Scope (shoot frequency and channels) confirmed after intake.

tiers.recommendedDetails: One planned local shoot, an agreed photo/video package and light digital-presence updates.
tiers.checkoutNote: Subscription checkout begins at $450/mo for the entry scope. The $650/mo example must be quoted and agreed before subscribing.

tiers.name: Full Growth Partner
tiers.description: Content plus Meta ads management combined. Scoped to your offer, market, and ad budget. No published ceiling.
tiers.scopeDriver: Bespoke. We define deliverables, ad management load, and reporting after a short intake.
includes: GBP and review support as needed

stripe.billingNote: Starting monthly rate. Ad spend is billed separately to your ad account. Final deliverables and reporting cadence confirmed after intake.

tiers.recommendedDetails: Ongoing production and Meta campaign management, scoped around your offer and market.
tiers.checkoutNote: Ad spend is separate and paid from your ad account.

faq.q: Where should I start if I have a small budget?
faq.a: Start with the $400–$600 GBP Content Refresh if you already have a usable website. A focused $500 visibility sprint is the example scope we suggest discussing for one local business location.

faq.q: What's the difference between the price range and the highlighted price?
faq.a: The published range is what a tier can cost. The highlighted amount is a suggested project scope, not a universal fixed quote. Checkout pages show their exact starting charge and we confirm the remaining project price and deliverables after intake.

faq.q: Can I book a $1,200 website or a $2,500 website and shoot?
faq.a: Yes, those are suggested project scopes within Website Only ($800–$1,500) and Website + Content Capture ($2,000–$2,800). Pages, complexity, shoot length and asset edits determine your quote.

faq.q: What does the suggested $650 monthly plan cover?
faq.a: It is a planning example for a local business that wants one content session each month, an agreed photo/video package and light digital-presence updates. The published retainer begins at $450 per month for a smaller scope; we confirm deliverables before you subscribe.

faq.q: Do I need to rebuild my website to work with SWFT?
faq.a: No. Start with a Google Business Profile/content refresh or a monthly content plan if the website you have is already working.

faq.q: Are ads and third-party subscriptions included?
faq.a: Ad spend, Webflow or Shopify plans, domains and other third-party fees are separate unless specifically included in your written proposal. Full Growth Partner management starts at $1,200 per month before ad spend.
One-time projects are scoped per engagement. Ongoing content retainers are month-to-month under the agreed scope.

faq.q: How long does a project take?
faq.a: Timing depends on the assets you supply, page count, shoot schedule, feedback and approval turnaround. We confirm a realistic timeline during intake.
